annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (ODPC), Kenya
key_provisions_or_claims: Data Commissioner urges ethical considerations and data protection principles when processing personal data with AI.
Privacy challenges noted: increased data collection, lack of informed consent, unauthorised data use for model training.
Recommends assessing AI-processing scope under data protection law and conducting DPIAs where necessary.
Legal practitioners urged to embed data protection in client governance structures per the Data Protection Act.
annotation.summary_en: Kenya ODPC news item reporting the Data Commissioner's remarks at the Law Society of Kenya conference, urging data protection principles, DPIAs and data subject rights compliance when using AI systems in legal practice and beyond.
annotation.title_clean: Compliance with Data Protection Regulations in Wake of Growing AI Regulations
